name: Leil Como 150 2-Person Indoor Sauna Kit
description: Leil Como 150 2-Person Indoor Sauna Features Premium 40mm ThermoWood® Construction : Thermally modified Scandinavian pine walls provide exceptional insulation, moisture resistance, and dimensional stability, ensuring the sauna withstands years of regular use without warping, rotting, or resin leakage. 2-Person Ergonomic Design : Wider 1.5-meter footprint with thoughtfully arranged interior provides generous shoulder room and comfortable seating for couples, with ergonomic bench layout ideal for relaxed conversation and shared wellness sessions. Tempered Glass Front Door : Premium 8mm clear tempered glass door with black hardware and premium handle creates an open, contemporary feel while maintaining excellent heat retention and durability for long-term daily use. Dual-Level Aspen Benches with Backrest : Two-tier bench system with smooth Aspen wood naturally stays cool-to-the-touch even in high heat, providing exceptional comfort and superior heat resistance compared to resinous woods like cedar. Two-Piece Insulated Ceiling : 15mm thermally modified ThermoWood® ceiling panels separated into two elements enhance heat retention, improve distribution, and simplify installation while maintaining structural integrity and optimal heating efficiency. Vertical Bar Front Wall Design : Clean minimalist architecture with vertical bar facade creates a sophisticated Scandinavian aesthetic while providing structural support and allowing unobstructed views of your wellness space. Engineered Soft Heat Airflow System : Adjustable ceiling vent and elevated base airflow design create balanced humidity-to-temperature ratio, preventing dry stinging heat sensation and allowing longer, deeper therapeutic sauna sessions. Adjustable Feet & Leveling System : M8x40 adjustable legs with rubber pads allow precise leveling on any indoor surface type, ensuring proper structural alignment and stable sauna operation on uneven floors or carpeting. Optional LED Lighting & Hexagon DECO Panels : Customizable ambient lighting system and decorative hexagon mosaic back wall panels transform your sauna into an elegant wellness retreat with spa-quality ambiance and personalized design. Modular Pre-Fabricated Assembly Kit : Pre-fabricated wall logs and ceiling elements with modular design allow two-three people to complete assembly in 5-7 hours using basic tools, with detailed instructions and all fasteners included in the kit. Nordic Heritage Engineering : Handcrafted in Estonia with 16+ years of sauna expertise, blending contemporary Nordic design principles with traditional sauna culture and rigorous testing for authentic, reliable performance. Saunum Air-Blending Compatible : Engineered to work seamlessly with Saunum heater systems that mix hot ceiling air with cooler floor air, eliminating "cold feet" and creating balanced, breathable warmth from head to toe. Leil Como 150 Specifications Product Name Leil Como 150 2-Person Indoor Sauna Kit Model Number Como 2-150 Capacity 2 persons Exterior Width 1,500mm (59.1 inches / 4.9 feet) Exterior Depth 1,437mm (56.6 inches / 4.7 feet) Exterior Height 2,200mm (86.6 inches / 7.2 feet) Interior Width 1,389mm (54.7 inches) Interior Depth 1,310mm (51.6 inches) Interior Height 1,995mm (78.6 inches) Wall Thickness 40mm (1.57 inches) ThermoWood® Ceiling Thickness 15mm STS ThermoWood® with two-piece insulated panels Interior Volume Approximately 1.8-2.0 cubic meters Door Type Clear tempered 8mm glass with black hardware and premium handle Door Dimensions 88mm thick, 690mm wide x 1,880mm tall Bench Configuration Dual-level Aspen bench system: Top bench 526mm x 1,389mm, Bottom bench 400mm x 905mm, Integrated backrest Estimated Assembly Weight 550-650 kg (1,210-1,430 lbs) assembled Shipping/Crate Weight Varies with packaging, shipped LTL freight Assembly Time 5-7 hours with 2-3 people (3 persons recommended for glass door installation) Warranty 2-year manufacturer's warranty covering materials, manufacturing defects, and pre-transport damage Material Standards Nordic Lunawood ThermoWood® (thermally modified pine), tempered glass, stainless steel hardware, Aspen benches Ventilation System Adjustable ceiling vent (100mm), elevated base airflow with dual-opening design Heater Compatibility Optional electric heaters 4-8kW (recommend Saunum, HUUM, or Harvia models; sold separately) Electrical Requirements 220-240V hardwired connection with dedicated breaker (heater-dependent amperage; 120V recommended for LED lighting) Floor Installation Requirements Stable, level surface with concrete foundation or driven piles; 600mm x 600mm minimum clearance around sauna required Design Awards Red Dot: Best of the Best 2024 international design recognition Customization Options Standard or Hexagon DECO decorative back wall panel, LED lighting packages (top bench, top bench + backrest options), various heater packages Assembly Kit Includes Pre-fabricated wall logs, ceiling elements, tempered glass door, dual benches with backrest, hardware, fasteners, ventilation valve, adjustable legs, installation manual, cable conduit for wiring Leil Como 150 Frequently Asked Questions Is the Como 150 appropriate for couples, and will two people fit comfortably? Yes, the Como 150 is specifically engineered for couples and two-person use. The 1.5-meter width provides generous shoulder room and relaxed comfort compared to the 1-person Como 120. The dual-level bench system is ergonomically arranged so both people can sit comfortably side-by-side or one person can recline partially on the larger top bench while the other sits on the lower level. The 1,995mm interior height accommodates seated and slightly reclined positions for extended wellness sessions together. What size room or space do I need for the Como 150 installation? The Como 150 exterior dimensions are 1,500mm wide x 1,437mm deep x 2,200mm tall. For safe installation and access, plan for a room at least 1,800mm x 1,700mm (6' x 5.5') minimum, with 600mm clearance space on all sides recommended for ventilation, airflow, and maintenance. The sauna can be placed in a corner by assembling the wall logs first, then positioning against the walls, but ensure adequate ventilation around the roof area. Consider ceiling height of at least 2,400mm to accommodate the 2,200mm sauna plus airflow above. What heater should I choose for the Como 150, and are heaters included? Heaters are sold separately and not included with the sauna kit. For the Como 150's 1.8-2.0 cubic meter interior volume, we recommend electric heaters in the 4-8kW capacity range. Leil particularly recommends Saunum heaters which feature patented air-blending technology that mixes hot ceiling air with cooler floor air, creating balanced warmth and eliminating "cold feet." Alternative options include HUUM or Harvia brands. Consult manufacturer heater sizing recommendations or contact sales to match your specific heat output needs and desired warm-up time. How difficult is assembly, and do I need professional installation? The Como 150 uses pre-fabricated modular wall logs that are easier to assemble than traditional barrel staves. Two capable people can complete assembly in 5-7 hours following the detailed installation manual included with your kit. A third person is strongly recommended, particularly for handling and installing the heavy 8mm tempered glass door safely. No professional installation is required if you have basic tools (hammer, screwdriver, drill) and follow instructions. However, electrical wiring must be completed by a certified electrician to ensure safety and local code compliance. What is ThermoWood® and why is it superior to regular cedar for saunas? ThermoWood® is Scandinavian pine that is heat-treated using only heat and steam (no chemicals) to remove internal moisture and resins. This thermal modification creates wood that is naturally resistant to warping, shrinking, rotting, and insect damage—far superior to untreated cedar, hemlock, or softwoods. ThermoWood® won't leak sticky resin even in extreme heat, maintains dimensional stability for decades without twisting, and develops a beautiful natural patina over time. The Como 150's 40mm thick ThermoWood® walls provide exceptional insulation, heat retention, and durability compared to standard sauna materials. Can I add LED lighting or decorative back wall panels to customize my sauna? Yes, the Como 150 offers excellent customization options. You can add optional LED lighting systems in two configurations: LED Lighting Set 1 for the top bench only, or LED Lighting Set 3 for both the top bench and integrated backrest, creating warm ambient illumination. The standard back wall can be upgraded to a beautiful Hexagon DECO decorative panel (1,389mm x 1,140mm) that adds visual elegance and spa-quality aesthetics. These options can be selected during purchase or added as upgrades, allowing you to personalize your wellness space design to match your interior décor. Does the Como 150 come with a warranty, and what does it cover? The Como 150 includes a comprehensive 2-year manufacturer's warranty covering defects in materials, manufacturing quality, and any damage occurring before transportation delivery. The warranty does not cover natural wood variations (such as color changes, knots, or small cracks), normal wear and tear from regular use, incorrect assembly or installation, force majeure events (natural disasters, wars), or unauthorized modifications. Claims must be filed within the warranty period by contacting the manufacturer with photographic documentation of the defect. What are the electrical and site preparation requirements for installation? The Como 150 requires a stable, level floor prepared with a concrete foundation or driven piles to ensure structural integrity and prevent settling over time. The sauna requires a 220-240V hardwired connection with a dedicated breaker for the electric heater (specific amperage depends on your chosen heater model). A dedicated 120V connection is also recommended for LED lighting and control systems if you order those options. We strongly recommend confirming exact electrical specifications with a qualified electrician based on your heater selection before installation to ensure full compliance with local electrical codes and safety standards. How long will the Como 150 last, and what maintenance does it require? With proper care, the Como 150 can provide 20+ years of reliable performance thanks to its ThermoWood® construction and premium materials. Annual maintenance is recommended: apply UV-protective exterior varnish to maintain color and protect against moisture/weathering, and treat wooden benches with specialized sauna bench oils for smooth, long-lasting comfort. The tempered glass door and stainless hardware require only routine cleaning with mild soap and water. Ensure proper ventilation during use to manage humidity. Regular maintenance preserves the sauna's structural integrity, appearance, and function throughout its lifetime. What is included in delivery, and how is the Como 150 shipped? The Como 150 is shipped fully crated via LTL (less-than-truckload) freight for curbside delivery to most US locations. The delivery includes the complete pre-fabricated sauna kit with all wall logs, two ceiling elements, tempered glass door, dual benches with backrest, ventilation valve, adjustable legs with rubber pads, all fasteners and hardware, electrical cable conduit, and comprehensive assembly instructions. Upon delivery, the driver will unload the crate at curb-side—you'll need at least two people to unpack and move components (approximately 45-60 minutes). Optional heaters and accessories typically ship separately. Inspect the crate for visible damage before signing delivery paperwork, and report any concealed damage within 5 business days.
